第七章当场疗伤
紧接着，便有一名身穿丹袍，身形消瘦的中年炼丹师从后厅出现，朝这边走来。
“李钧？”看到这中年人，苏尘眼睛一眯。这中年人他有印象，名叫李钧，记得前世，这李钧就是五宝堂的一个见习炼丹师。
前世的苏尘，曾经无意中和这个李钧打过交道，当时此人便是眼高于顶，讥刺苏尘为废物。
想不到重活一世，会这么快就重新碰见李钧。
“李丹师来了！”
“李丹师可是五宝堂的中级见习炼丹师，平时很少现身，想不到今天会出现。”
众人议论纷纷，就连那老者和少女，听到李钧是见习炼丹师，也不由得多看李钧一眼。
要知道，在清河城这种小城，见习炼丹师可是非常难得一见。
“刚才是你说，这位老前辈的伤势，不能用百年至阳草疗伤？”李钧径直走到苏尘面前，上下打量着苏尘，问道。
“和你有关系吗？”苏尘反问。
“无知小儿！”
李钧竖起眉头，怒斥一声，“被冰鳞蟒所伤，当然应该使用至阳草这一类的至阳药物作为疗伤主材，如果是百年至阳草效果更佳，这是所有炼丹师都知道的常识。你一个外行人，什么都不知道，就大放厥词，我作为中级见习炼丹师，自然应该阻止你。”
李钧一边说，一边目光暗暗瞟向一旁的老者和少女。他当然有自己的小算盘，这老者和少女看打扮和气质就不像普通人，自己若是能治疗其伤势的话，他们必定会念自己的恩情，这对自己的前途是极其有益的。
李钧这厢打着自己的小算盘，那厢苏尘却压根不给李钧半分面子，冷笑道：“你才是一派胡言。”
李钧顿时暴怒，喝道：“你算个什么东西，我是中级见习炼丹师，凭你也敢质疑我？”
苏尘却没有理会李钧，转身对那少女道：“你爷爷的伤势我可以治疗，不需要用到百年至阳草，只需要最普通的阳元石就可以。我愿意帮你们治疗，条件是把百年至阳草让给我。”
苏尘此话一出，顿时在五宝堂内引起轩然大波。
“我没听错吧？这少年竟然质疑中级见习炼丹师？”
“他还自称能够治疗冰鳞蟒的咬伤？我看他连炼丹学徒都不是，吹牛吹得太过火了吧？”

就连李钧也是哑然失笑，不屑道：“我还以为你要说什么呢？就凭你这毛都没长齐的小子，也敢自称能治疗冰鳞蟒的伤势？还不用百年至阳草？我看你是脑袋秀逗了，还是吃错药了？”
苏尘不理会李钧，而是看向少女，平静道：“今天你若是相信我，我可以帮你将老人家的伤势治好。若是不相信我，等我出了五宝堂的大门，你到时候再后悔也晚了。”
李钧大声道：“尊贵的小姐，你不用听这毛头小子信口雌黄，我以中级见习炼丹师的名誉担保，他说的全是一派胡言。被冰鳞蟒咬伤，属于复杂疑难的伤势，必须用百年至阳草医治才行，而且今天整个五宝堂，只有在下一人有能力医治。”
双方各执一词，一时间场中所有目光都聚集在少女身上，想知道少女会选择相信谁。
少女沉吟片刻，显然很难抉择。
片刻后，她朱唇微咬，看向苏尘：“公子，我也略懂丹道，我想知道你为什么说我爷爷的伤势用百年至阳草无法治疗，反而会更严重？”
content_en:
Chapter 7 Healing on the Spot
Immediately afterwards, a thin, middle-aged alchemist wearing an alchemy robe appeared from the back hall and walked towards this side.
"Li Jun?" Su Chen narrowed his eyes when he saw this middle-aged man. He had an impression of this middle-aged man named Li Jun. He remembered that in his previous life, this Li Jun was a trainee alchemist in Wubao Hall.
In the previous life, Su Chen had accidentally dealt with this Li Jun. At that time, this man was too conceited and ridiculed Su Chen as a waste.
I never expected that I would meet Li Jun again so soon after reviving my life.
"Master Li is here!"
"Alchemist Li is an intermediate trainee alchemist from Wubao Hall. He rarely shows up. I didn't expect him to show up today."
Everyone was talking about it, and even the old man and the girl couldn't help but take a second look at Li Jun when they heard that Li Jun was a trainee alchemist.
You know, in a small town like Qinghe City, it is very rare to find a trainee alchemist.
"Did you just say that this old man's injury cannot be treated with Centennial Sun Grass?" Li Jun walked directly to Su Chen, looked at Su Chen up and down, and asked.
"Does it have anything to do with you?" Su Chen asked.
"Ignorant child!"
Li Jun raised his brows and rebuked angrily, "If you are injured by an ice-scaled python, of course you should use a Zhiyang medicine such as Zhiyang grass as the main healing material. If it is a century-old Zhiyang grass, it will be more effective. This is common sense that all alchemists know. You are a layman and don't know anything, so you talk nonsense. As an intermediate trainee alchemist, I should naturally stop you."
As Li Jun spoke, he secretly glanced at the old man and girl beside him. Of course he had his own little calculation. The old man and the girl looked different from ordinary people in appearance and temperament. If he could treat their injuries, they would definitely appreciate his kindness, which would be extremely beneficial to his future.
Li Jun was making his own little plans this time, but Su Chen didn't give Li Jun any face at all and sneered: "You are full of nonsense."
Li Jun suddenly became furious and shouted: "Who do you think you are? I am an intermediate trainee alchemist. How dare you question me?"
Su Chen ignored Li Jun, turned around and said to the girl: "I can treat your grandfather's injury. You don't need to use the Hundred-Year Sun Herb, just the most common Yang Yuan Stone. I am willing to help you with the treatment, on the condition that you give me the Hundred-Year Sun Herb."
As soon as Su Chen said these words, it immediately caused an uproar in the Five Treasures Hall.
"Did I hear you correctly? This young man actually questioned an intermediate trainee alchemist?"
"He also claims to be able to cure the bite of the ice-scaled python? I think he is not even an alchemy apprentice. Isn't he bragging too much?"
Even Li Jun laughed dumbly and said disdainfully: "I thought you were going to say something? How dare you, a boy with no hair at all, claim to be able to cure the injuries of ice-scaled pythons? Why don't you use century-old Sun Herb? I think you are having fun with your brain, or have you taken the wrong medicine?"
Su Chen ignored Li Jun, but looked at the girl and said calmly: "If you believe me today, I can help you heal the old man's injury. If you don't believe me, wait until I leave the gate of Wubaotang, and it will be too late for you to regret it."
Li Jun said loudly: "Dear young lady, you don't have to listen to this brat's nonsense. I guarantee as an intermediate trainee alchemist that what he said is nonsense. Being bitten by an ice-scale python is a complicated and difficult injury that must be treated with the century-old Sun Herb. And today in the entire Five Treasures Hall, only the next person is capable of healing."
Both parties held their own opinions, and for a while all eyes in the field were focused on the girl, wondering who the girl would choose to believe.
The girl pondered for a moment, obviously having a hard time making a decision.
After a moment, she bit her red lips slightly and looked at Su Chen: "Sir, I also know a little about alchemy. I want to know why you said that my grandfather's injury cannot be treated with the century-old Sun Herb, but will instead become more serious?"
